question: If 45% of a number is 0.9 more than 30% of it, what is the number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in percentage = 45% − 30% = 15%

Value of 15% of the number = 0.9

1% of the number = 0.9 ÷ 15 = 0.06

100% of the number = 0.06 × 100 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

45% of a number is 0.9 more than 30% of it.

**Calculations:**

Let the number be x.

⇒ 45% of x − 30% of x = 0.9

⇒ (45 − 30)% of x = 0.9

⇒ 15% of x = 0.9

⇒ (15 ÷ 100) × x = 0.9

⇒ x = 0.9 × (100 ÷ 15)

⇒ x = 90 ÷ 15

⇒ x = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Difference

When comparing two percentages of the same base value, the difference between their absolute values is equal to the percentage of the difference applied to the base. Formula: a% of x − b% of x = (a − b)% of x.

Base of Percentage

A percentage is always calculated on a base value (considered as 100%). Finding the unknown base given a percentage value involves multiplying the value by 100 and dividing by the given percentage.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage into a fraction, divide the value by 100. For example, 15% is equivalent to 15 ÷ 100 or 3 ÷ 20 in simplified fractional form.
